policy: Every entry is an OPEN gap, not an approved exception: status PROPOSED, approver UNASSIGNED. The gate treats PROPOSED waivers as not covering anything; an APPROVED waiver needs approver, expiry <= 90 days, compensating control, and is refused once expired.

waivers.gap: Real HashiCorp Vault not available: adapter exercised only against the in-repo KV v2 wire double
waivers.remediation: Provision a staging Vault 1.15+; run tests/ with INV55_VAULT_ADDR; record versions

waivers.gap: Provider at-rest encryption / KMS auto-unseal not provisioned
waivers.remediation: Provision KMS/HSM auto-unseal; attach Vault seal config evidence

waivers.gap: External IdP/SPIFFE issuer and INV-59 policy engine not bound; in-repo HMAC verifier and ScopePolicy used
waivers.remediation: Bind issuer JWKS verifier and INV-59 adapter behind existing seams

waivers.gap: Far-edge disconnected operation unsupported; stale serving refused in production
waivers.remediation: Approve a stale-serving policy per site or keep unsupported

waivers.gap: No OS confinement or memory-hard handling verifiable in pure Python
waivers.remediation: Deploy with isolation controls; accept or mitigate residual risk T-17

waivers.gap: Only reference-host in-process benchmarks; no certified environment, soak, fleet, power/thermal
waivers.remediation: Run bench/soak on the certified environment and record

waivers.gap: No deployment platform for canary automation
waivers.remediation: Implement rollout controller on the platform

waivers.gap: No log/trace shipping pipeline or release-lineage graph
waivers.remediation: Wire exporters to the platform's pipelines

waivers.gap: No signing identity for releases; SHA256SUMS only
pk_core and series MASTER.md absent from the upload
waivers.remediation: Supply pk_core and MASTER.md; re-run tests/test_component.py

waivers.gap: Project licence not chosen by the owner
waivers.remediation: Owner selects a licence; add LICENSE
